### Main questions

We set out to understand the role of hypoxia in astrocytes.


### 1.0 Package requirements

- change to current working directory `/nemo/lab/luscomben/home/users/palk/Projects/012-Ben-Clarke-ERAP1-KD/analysis` and include required packages

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

setwd("/nemo/lab/patanir/home/users/palk/Projects/012-Ben-Clarke-ERAP1-KD/analysis")
require("stringr")
require("rtracklayer")
require("biomaRt")
require("ggplot2")
require("RColorBrewer")

```

- Set paths

```{r}

analysis_path <- "14-erap2-kd-proteomics/"
save_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "rdata_files")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "plots")
input_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "input_files")
output_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "output_files")
tmp_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "tmp")

dir.create(save_dir)
dir.create(plot_dir)
dir.create(input_dir)
dir.create(output_dir)
dir.create(tmp_dir)

```



### Load annotation file



- Load significantly differentially enriched proteins

```{r}

significantly_affected_proteins_df <- read.csv(file.path(output_dir, "05-pairwise-grouped-significantly-affected-proteins.csv"))

```

- Load list of cytokines

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

cytokine_df <- read.table(file.path(input_dir, "cytokine-from-human-protein-atlas.tsv"), sep = "\t", header = T)

cytokine_df[cytokine_df$Gene %in% significantly_affected_proteins_df$protein_name,]

secreted_proteins <- cytokine_df[cytokine_df$Gene %in% significantly_affected_proteins_df$protein_name & (grepl(x = cytokine_df$Protein.class,pattern = "secreted") | 
    grepl(x = cytokine_df$Secretome.function, pattern = "Cytokine") |
    grepl(x = cytokine_df$Secretome.function, pattern = "Interleukin")),c(1:15,61,62,63,66,67,73,74,75,76)]
secreted_proteins_out_df <- cbind(significantly_affected_proteins_df[match(secreted_proteins$Gene, significantly_affected_proteins_df$protein_name),], secreted_proteins[,-1])

write.csv(x = secreted_proteins_out_df, file = file.path(output_dir, "08-secreted-proteins-from-human-protein-atlas.csv"))

```
